span.p:
leaves walked in the order
of _morton_key(i, j), 21 bits
per axis: Z-order keeps every
node's descendants contiguous
at EVERY level

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 250px; text-align: center;

span.p:
_coarsen_records(): pitch and
step doubled per level, with a
class-aware union of z-intervals
- interior nodes carry real
downsampled geometry

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 250px; text-align: center;

span.p:
a changed key at level lv
means that node saw its last
child: _flush_node() writes
node_lv_i_j.glb, frees it and
feeds the level above - one
open node per level

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 250px; text-align: center;

span.p:
tileset_cli: from-store or
from-payload - the .bin + .idx.json
of tiled_exporter, leaf tile 100 m

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 250px; text-align: center;

span.p:
tile_ti.glb (leaves) and
node_lv_i_j.glb (interior)
EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing: one
unit-box mesh per class, with
per-instance TRANSLATION
and SCALE

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 250px; text-align: center;

span.p:
tileset.json - quadtree,
refine REPLACE, geometricError
8 x cell_xy x 2^level (leaves 0)
root.transform: EPSG:3946 grid
to ECEF, geoid via EPSG:5720,
grid convergence corrected
